about: Provenance of every image and clip under src/images/ and src/video/ (Dermot, 21 November 2026: "Add the list too"). Built from the record (story-bible/images.md, image-prompts.md, video-prompts.md, src/video/README.md, the CHANGELOG and the commits that wrote each file), never by eye; "unrecorded" where the record does not settle it. Files filed from 21 November 2026 are also tagged in the file (scripts/tag-provenance.js), which keeps this list current. Checked by scripts/check-provenance-list.js.

sources.photograph: his frame as taken, cropped, darkroom-only, or healed by hand from the same frame
sources.edited-ai: his frame altered by a generative tool
sources.composite-ai: generated and other elements put together
sources.generated: made by a generative model (a Grok clip and its poster included)
sources.composite: elements put together by hand, nothing generated
sources.card: a designed card, emblem, diagram or icon
sources.third-party: stock or other people's media under their own terms
sources.unrecorded: the record does not settle it
